newsitem.title: UK: Prism says no problems with rail operations.
newsitem.headline: Prism says no problems with rail operations.

text.p: British railway operator Prism Rail Plc said on Friday that none of its franchises had experienced any of the operational problems seen on South West Trains and that trading was currently in line with expectations.
The group issued a trading update in response to the recent sharp fall in the company's share price.
South West Trains is a unit of Stagecoach Holdings Plc.

Prism believed the recent fall in its share was the "result of the publicity concerning the failure of South West Trains to meet its passenger service requirements and concerns that other rail operators will encounter similar difficulties".
Prism's share price has fallen from a high of 580 pence on January 17 to close at 295 pence on Thursday. It was quoted at around 340-350 pence on Friday.
South West Trains came under criticism recently following the cancellation of numerous services after job reductions left it with too few drivers to operate all services.
